# skycloak_captcha_domain (Resource)

A hostname registered for CAPTCHA protection on a cluster. The number of registrable hostnames is capped per cluster; the API rejects additions beyond the cap.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_captcha_domain" "login" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  hostname   = "login.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname to protect. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Registration timestamp.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/hostname`.
